author: Jason Stys
summary: Compare signed native OPA policy decisions across MFA, expiry and registry-bound contexts.
rationale: Explains gained and lost access using authenticated synthetic evidence without changing cloud permissions.
limitations: Permissions reflect a fixed synthetic Rego model, not real cloud login or effective provider authorization.
MFA contexts are signed assertions, not proof that an actual challenge was completed.
Registry/context signature checks do not change real cloud permissions or establish every deployed identity control.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
